name: @hl-bos/site-builder
description: HLG Instant Site Builder engine. Turns a Presence Scanner lead into a one-page demo website for its vertical (contractor, salon/barber, restaurant/bar, professional services; one registry entry per vertical), or a verified Business Profile into a private internal draft, in the shared HLG static-site design: facts only from the lead's evidence, sample content clearly marked, copy from a validated Claude writer or the deterministic template writer, a launch checklist derived from the lead's findings, and a downloadable ZIP. Renders a single self-contained HTML file with no scripts. Never publishes anything.
